findings.title: Async function calls sync function without await
findings.body: `converted_cents` is an async function that calls `fetch_rate` without `await`, so the call returns a coroutine object instead of the expected `Decimal` rate. Mark `fetch_rate` as async and await it, or make `converted_cents` synchronous.
findings.suggestion:
rate = await fetch_rate(pair)
    return round(amount_cents * rate)

findings.title: Async function lacks async I/O
findings.body: `converted_cents` is declared `async` but performs no I/O or async operations. Either remove the `async` keyword and make it synchronous, or add an awaited async call (e.g., `await fetch_rate(pair)`).
